value.name: Micky approaches the crack house
value.description: Micky walks down the driveway as Alice heads up to the front porch, establishing movement around the crack house.
evidence: Micky walks down the driveway of the crack house as Alice walks up to the front porch.

value.name: Dicky is found high with Karen and BooBoo
value.description: Inside the crack house, Dicky is making out with Karen while BooBoo smokes crack beside them, showing they have been up for days and are heavily intoxicated.
evidence: Dicky open mouth makes out with Karen, his Cambodian girlfriend, BooBoo sits next to them smoking crack.
They've been up for days, eyes racing, high.

value.name: Dicky learns his mother is outside
value.description: Wolfie shouts from downstairs that Dicky's mother is outside, triggering Dicky's panic.
evidence: WOLFIE (shouts from downstairs) Dicky, YOUR MUTHUAH'S OUTSIDE!
DICKY (real fear in his eyes) I'm not here!

value.name: Dicky flees through the window
value.description: Trying to avoid his mother, Dicky rushes to a back kitchen window, climbs out, and jumps from the second floor.
evidence: Dicky rushes for an open window in the back of the kitchen, 2nd floor of the crack house.
Dicky climbs out the window and jumps...

value.name: Dicky lands badly in the alley
value.description: Dicky crashes into garbage bags and the filthy ground, injuring his back as he stumbles to his feet.
evidence: Dicky flying, falling... lands hard on top of some garbage bags...Bounces onto the filthy ground.
He rolls over, his back fucked. Stumbles up to his feet, grimacing...

value.name: Micky confronts Dicky about his behavior
value.description: Micky waits in the backyard and angrily asks Dicky what he is doing after the escape.
evidence: Micky stands there waiting in the back yard, watching.
MICKY What the fuck are you doin'?

value.name: Dicky begs Micky to hide him from Ma
value.description: Dicky whispers that Micky should not tell their mother he is there and asks to be picked up later at the house.
evidence: DICKY (WHISPERS) Don't tell Ma I'm here, pick me up back at the house, I'll go through the yahds -
DICKY (WHISPERS) Pick me up at the house!

value.name: Micky insists they leave for the airport
value.description: Micky tells Dicky they need to go to the airport immediately because the fight is important and their flight is waiting.
evidence: MICKY We gotta go to the airport now. You know how important this fight is.
MICKY (BOOSTING DICKY) Hurry up, she's out front, and we gotta flight to catch.

value.name: Micky helps Dicky climb the fence
value.description: Micky boosts Dicky onto a fence so he can get away while their mother is outside.
evidence: Micky gives Dicky a boost onto a fence to climb over.
MICKY (BOOSTING DICKY) Hurry up, she's out front, and we gotta flight to catch.

value.name: George interrupts their escape
value.description: As Dicky struggles over the fence, George charges toward them and interrupts the moment.
evidence: But as Dicky struggles to climbing over, George comes charging toward them.
